user_prompt: Please select the single project from this shortlist of 20 that best matches Fatima Sarah Khalid values and scoring criteria. State your winner clearly and explain your reasoning in 3-4 sentences.
raw_response:
**Winner: Decidim**

Decidim stands out as the clear winner because it embodies nearly all of my core values. It is a genuinely open source, community-governed civic commons platform deployed by hundreds of governments worldwide, demonstrating its commitment to public infrastructure over commercial interests. Its cooperative governance model (Decidim Free Software Association) ensures structural inclusion and community-driven decision-making, while its focus on participatory democracy aligns perfectly with intersectional feminist principles of collective empowerment. The project also lowers barriers for developers to contribute to civic tech while maintaining long-term sustainability through its cooperative structure.
